# ZigZag Agile Learning Community

> A self-directed homeschool program in Asheville, North Carolina (24 Thompson Rd, Asheville, NC 28806) for homeschooled and unschooled kids ages 4-18, running since 2015. Kids choose their own classes, projects and play, Tuesday to Thursday, 9:30 am to 3:30 pm, on three acres near Bent Creek with fields, trees, a creek, ponds, a treehouse and indoor classroom spaces (kitchen, workshop, art studio, music building, aerial silks). ZigZag is part of the international Agile Learning Centers (ALC) network. It is a drop-off program and an alternative to traditional school, not a school itself: kids 7 and older must be registered NC homeschoolers.

## What makes ZigZag different
- Kids are treated as people, just smaller: their needs count as much as adults' needs, and their "no" is a real answer.
- Learning is lifelong and intrinsic. There is no required curriculum; kids pick what to learn from 30+ classes a semester (theatre, biology, Beats Lab, D&D, aerial silks, pottery, finance, cooking and more) plus offerings they lead themselves.
- Every morning starts in Pods, small groups where kids check in, set intentions and build the culture together.
- Mixed ages 4-18 learn side by side. Self-direction is practiced as a skill: choosing, committing, following through, and working out conflict together.
- Six core values: harmony, community, connection, care, agility and choice.
- Featured on the front page of the Asheville Citizen Times (January 26, 2020): "A day in the life of Asheville's unschooled."
- Documentary: "Live and Let Learn - A Day at ZigZag ALC" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eSPX3spdBUU).

## Tuition
- Two 16-week semesters a year (Fall and Spring), each with one week off mid-semester.
- $3,440 per semester for 3 days a week, paid in four installments per semester, all supplies included.
- A limited number of work-trade spots for families with handyperson skills.

## Visiting
- Families start with a tour: https://zigzagalc.org/contact/
- Open house: Sunday, December 6, 2026, 2:00 to 4:30 pm, drop in any time.
